name: Tool — Azure AI Search
summary: AzureAISearchTool against a customer-owned search index, attached to a BYOM-routed agent.
description: `AzureAISearchTool` attaches an Azure AI Search index to a Prompt Agent whose orchestrator model is BYOM-routed. It lets users retrieve from their own search index while the agent response is generated by `{connection}/{deployment}` through APIM AI Gateway.
notes:
Verified end-to-end with `AzureAISearchTool` on a BYOM-prefixed Prompt Agent. See `test.py`.

Use `AzureAISearchTool(azure_ai_search=AzureAISearchToolResource(indexes=[AISearchIndexResource(project_connection_id=..., index_name=..., query_type=..., top_k=...)]))`. The older kwargs-style constructor (`connection_id`, `index_name`) does not exist in `azure-ai-projects`; set `AZURE_AI_SEARCH_CONNECTION_ID` and `AZURE_AI_SEARCH_INDEX_NAME` to run.
